rows.text: [Trailblazer], do you remember why we came to the Luofu this time?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Of course I do! To witness you becoming the Express' greatest sword master!
That was important, too! But that was not our original reason, was it?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We came to take part in the Wardance, didn't we?
That's right! If I hadn't asked, you'd have forgotten!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We originally came as VIP guests to take part in the Wardance! Then, as expected, we ran into accidents!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We successfully captured Hoolay on the Skysplitter and General Jing Yuan decided to formally hold the Wardance for real
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I have two Masters that got me nice benefits, so I've managed to get two staff passes for you and Dan Heng. You can come straight to the Skysplitter backstage without any trouble!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm amazing, right? Where is my praise?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thank you, Super-March! I knew I could count on you!
You're the best! Dan Heng was so frosty. All he said was something about: "One should maintain a proper distance from contestants when spectating sports..." Such a buzz kill~
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What's so good about going backstage? I feel like spectators should keep their distance from competitors

That's weird. That's pretty much what Dan Heng said... But you'll be able to see all kinds of things backstage that you won't see anywhere else! You know the Xianzhou saying: "A minute on stage is ten years of hard work offstage!"
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Forget it. I don't care if you two come or not! Humph!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm going back to training. Chat later!
rows.speaker: March 7th
